schema.name: WeftEnvelope
schema.doc: The triad-1 wire envelope per docs 03-ENVELOPE and core/c/weft.h. Byte-layout and validation semantics are normative: [0..4) magic 'WEFT', [4..6) version u16, [6..8) header_size u16, [8..12) seq u32, [12..16) payload_len u32. validateHeader() mirrors weft_envelope_decode() as a non-throwing boolean handshake (Law 4).

fields.name: headerSize
fields.doc: Total header size; payload begins at this offset, NEVER at 16 (L8b extensible headers).

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Monotonic frame sequence number; mirrors the buffer canary.

fields.name: payloadLen
fields.doc: Payload byte length starting at headerSize.
